deliverables: 12 months of production maintenance for Cardano hardware-wallet support
Maintenance of supporting interoperability libraries and cardano-hw-cli
Support for integration paths involving externally maintained components where shared hardware-wallet flows intersect
Vendor-required product or security audits where firmware or app changes trigger them
Milestone-based disbursement controls and transparent capped T&M reporting
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.
request.what: Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 for Cardano hardware-wallet support, including Ledger and Trezor compatibility updates, interoperability libraries, cardano-hw-cli, developer support, shared hardware-wallet integration paths, and vendor-required audits.

claims.claim: Cardano hardware-wallet support must be maintained continuously or users and integrators may lose secure access when Cardano, Ledger, or Trezor introduce breaking changes.
The proposal funds 12 months of production maintenance for Cardano hardware-wallet support rather than building a new wallet product.
The requested budget totals 1,310,960 ada, consisting of 1,272,777 ada for hardware-wallet maintenance and compatibility assurance plus a 38,183 ada Intersect administration fee.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not breach the cited 350M Net Change Limit at the time of submission, either alone or in aggregate.
Independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
Intersect will use a Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework with a 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract for this project.

The Oversight Committee consists of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl, and will verify key administrative actions using on-chain logic without discretion over governance decisions.
A public dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is available for the community to audit and track metrics related to the withdrawn ada, with activity also verifiable on chain.
The proposal aligns with Cardano strategy pillars related to security, interoperability, developer experience, adoption, and compatibility with common tooling.

summary: The document requests 1,310,960 ada for a 12-month continuity maintenance program for Cardano hardware-wallet support, submitted by Intersect on behalf of a vendor, with smart-contract-based treasury administration, named oversight participants, and references to voting, audit, and tracking resources.
